_comment: ⚑ R3 (plan-resource-costs-feedback §5.2): this cost is now an ENTRY price, not a sustain rate. R2 made a slow aura charge only when it NEWLY slows something — re-applying the same fraction to a mob already slowed moves nothing but the expiry timer — and the applier authors the buff lifetime as tickInterval + 1, so a mob that stays in the ring stays slowed for free. You pay per mob that walks in. Priced x3, borrowing the dot's whole-burn heuristic: a slow has no natural duration to price against, so this is an engagement charge. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
